parsed.explanation: National parent regime creates tier-1 traveler exposures: binary passport policy, visa refusal/fraud scrutiny on document discrepancy, ban on trans use of government single-sex facilities, and documented birth-sex custody with hormone removal and abuse in immigration detention. These are partly contested/enjoined and do not include a documented local bathroom ban in this state. Offset: this state has longstanding gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime enhancements, abolition of the panic defence, documented civil-rights enforcement including a 2026 court finding for striking a trans woman, and 88% public support for protections. Resident-only surgery/care/sports rules are not counted directly, and the 72-incident raw count has no denominator. Net: unremedied national exposure with working local recourse.
